reviews.text: I left my 3-month-old dachshund puppy with a sitter for an evening when I couldn't take him. Everything went extremely well!!! Ulyss was with two friends; the initial meeting made me feel confident, and I was reassured to leave him knowing he was in good hands ❤️🫶 I recommend it 100%! The concept is brilliant, and the pet sitters are fantastic. He was pampered ☺️

Thank you to Noa and the whole team!!
My dog ​​loves her pack hikes; she always comes back happy, well-fed, and relaxed. The walks are perfectly organized, and you can tell the dogs are in very good hands.

Noa is also very friendly, passionate, accommodating, and always available. It's truly reassuring to be able to entrust your dog to her with complete confidence.
Pablo is always happy to go on outings with his friends and his dog sitter! I'm delighted to be able to entrust my dog ​​to her with complete confidence, whether for a walk or for the holidays!

Amazing team! My dog ​​Poly, who is very timid, loves going hiking with Noa. They create incredible moments for them. I have complete trust in the whole team, who take such good care of our furry friends.

I recommend them 10,000%! 🐶❤️
Top-notch

We've entrusted Aria to Noa several times, whether for pet sitting, hiking, or walks, and everything has always gone perfectly! We have complete confidence in her. She's passionate and never hesitates to spend time with the dogs. Aria adores her, and so do we! We highly recommend her!
My dog ​​always comes back happy and very tired. They take care of our dogs with love and kindness!!! Thank you to them ☀️🫶🏽 …
I regularly leave my dog ​​with me on hikes, and I have complete confidence in him. The photos and videos I receive capture the joy and fun of the dogs; it's a real pleasure to entrust him to me 😁 …

I have a particularly playful Staffordshire Bull Terrier. He needs a lot of exercise, and hikes with Pepette make him especially happy.
The attention the team gives our dogs is truly remarkable, and I recommend them 100%!
A fantastic team! Our dog Tao seems to love the walks and dog-sitting sessions! I highly recommend them.

My little Gus comes back happy, joyful, and peaceful from every hike! Thanks to the girls, he loves going in the water and sharing wonderful moments with his little four-legged friends 🐾
Thank you for him 🐩 …

I leave Gigi with them without any worries, despite her minor behavioral issues on walks with me (she's overly reactive to certain noises). Noa and Mélanie are incredibly responsible and handle everything perfectly. Gigi loves her walks! It's such a pleasure to receive such great photos while I'm at work! I recommend them 1000%!

Robyn's little life has changed so much since we met Noa and Mélanie in Marseille! She's having a blast hiking with her friends, and it makes life so much easier for me! Thanks, girls, for this service for our dogs and for us busy dog ​​parents, lol!

I entrust my little dachshund to Noa from MaPepette very regularly and without hesitation. Having dogs herself, she trusted her immediately, and my dog ​​adores her! She knows how to take care of our animals and gives us updates throughout the day with photos and videos. Thank you to her and thank you to the MaPepette team for your wonderful work!

We left Arnold with Noa for three days while my wife was in labor. It was the first time we'd used a sitter, and everything went wonderfully. Noa was very understanding and adapted to our schedule. Arnold was able to go for long walks every day and had a fantastic time. I highly recommend her! 👌 …

I left my dog ​​Vasko for three days for the first time. The experience was fantastic! Great walks and naps with his friends.

I received regular updates with photos and videos; it was lovely to see my dog ​​having fun, and it reassured me! I highly recommend it! Vasko loved it 😉
My dog ​​comes back so happy and exhausted from his trips with the group. He has friends he loves to see and he's so happy to get in the car for the hikes. I recommend Ma Pepette 100%!
The team is lovely and incredibly well-organized. My dog ​​loves the Pépettes hikes ❤️ Thank you for her!
A paradise for pups! Aska is always thrilled to see the team again. They are true dog lovers who treat each animal with immense tenderness and professionalism. Go without hesitation!
Excellent dog sitting and pack walks. The staff are professional and take great care of the dogs. I recommend them 100%.

A huge thank you to the whole team! A fantastic team, always attentive and professional. The hikes go wonderfully, my dog ​​is always happy to go hiking 😊 You can tell they truly love dogs and take care of them with passion. I highly recommend them, it's amazing! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ …
Noa is a fantastic dog sitter. She took the time to get to know our dog and then took excellent care of him. We would entrust him to her again with complete confidence.
A fantastic team! My dog ​​Valco absolutely loves walks with Noa and Mélanie. Thank you to them for being so professional and kind to the dogs. I highly recommend them!
The meeting and care of our dog went very well. A big thank you to Noa for her professionalism.

For the past year, we've entrusted our little Australian Shepherd to the wonderful team at Pepette every week.

We're delighted, and judging by my dog's enthusiasm, she's very happy too :) I recommend them 100%!
A reliable, efficient, and passionate team. Their service, including group hikes, is a real treat for my dog ​​when I'm not available. I highly recommend them.

I highly recommend them!

A fantastic team.
Noa always looks after my daughter and she's amazing!

A huge thank you to my little one and Valentine! Despite a complicated departure due to an unforeseen event, she reacted very quickly to find a solution and allowed me to leave with peace of mind. She was reassuring from the very first contact, regularly sent me updates and photos of my dog ​​during my trip, and even checked in after she looked after me. A truly passionate and trustworthy person!
I highly recommend her!

I highly recommend using Ma Pépette for dog sitting! My dog ​​was pampered throughout her stay, with lovely walks (hikes) and lots of cuddles. I was delighted to see her happy little face in the daily photos and videos I received. I would definitely use their services again! Thank you for everything! 🐶🐾💖 …

Thank you to Valentine and Mélanie who were incredibly responsive in finding us a last-minute pet-sitting solution for Uma. Uma, our American Shepherd, came back delighted with her stay, having enjoyed lots of walks. We felt completely confident and received many photos and videos of Uma's time there.

Our Billie's (a one-year-old Cocker Spaniel) weekly treat: outings in nature with other dogs and a team that takes excellent care of her! I highly recommend them! We also tried their weekend boarding service: a fantastic experience. I entrust my dog ​​to them without hesitation. Thank you, Pépette! :)

I called on my friend Pepette to look after my dog, the first time he'd been cared for by "strangers." I was immediately reassured by their approach: we had an initial meeting beforehand to make sure the host family's dogs got along with mine. And during the stay, I received photos and videos of my dog ​​very regularly. What a joy to see that he was in a healthy environment, going for walks every day with lots of other dogs! Thank you again for taking such good care of our animals; I left with complete peace of mind!

Fantastic hikes for our four-legged friends! They always come back smiling and well-fed! The whole team is wonderful, attentive, and accommodating. I leave my dog ​​with them without hesitation two to four times a month!

I recommend them 1000%!

For the past year, our Australian Shepherd has been going hiking with my little girl in Marseille, and it's fantastic. We highly recommend them :) The same goes for the pet sitters; they take wonderful care of our Sirius 🏡 …

A fantastic dog-sitting option: lots of hikes, lots of friends, and plenty of cuddles for your furry friend. The dog sitters are organized, available, and very attentive to our dog's needs. Thank you! 🤩 …
My little darlings, they're like second moms to my Charlie, you can trust them completely! ♡
Fantastic hike, Pepette! My dog ​​came back with a huge smile on his face and thoroughly tired from his day in nature :) The team is super friendly and very professional! I highly recommend it ;)
So happy with the Ma Pépette hikes! My dog ​​Jiao loves the team, has a blast, and most importantly, gets plenty of exercise. It's really convenient, I recommend it 100%!

Ma Pepette is so much more than just dog sitters, it's a dog paradise in Marseille!! I entrust my dog ​​to them every week, and during his walks, he fully enjoys nature, running in the hills with his friends. A professional, trustworthy, passionate, and attentive team. I recommend them without hesitation!!
You can go with your eyes closed, everything is great!! They are the best, our little ones are in good hands ++++++
What a great group of walkers who take such good care of my dog ​​every week on hikes!

My darling, I give her a 100% thumbs up! You can trust her completely.
Talented, available, and dedicated to your furry friends, she gives dogs a fantastic time in the hills of Marseille with lots of friends and tons of cuddles! A dream come true!!

I highly recommend Ma Pepette, both for pet sitting and walks. Our dog comes back super happy and tired from every walk, and we can see that his shy and fearful behavior is improving tremendously. During the pet sitting sessions, he quickly forgets about us because he feels so comfortable! We entrust him to them with complete peace of mind every time.
Perfect dog sitter!! 🐶 …

A fantastic team, truly caring about the well-being of our animals.
I highly recommend them! ☺️
I recommend Ma Pepette to any pet owner who would like to have their four-legged companion looked after with complete peace of mind 🙏🏼 thank you Mélanie! …

You can leave your dog with them without hesitation; the team is passionate, dedicated, and attentive.

We happily left Snow there, and so did he!

We highly recommend them!!

A very available and dedicated dog sitter who loves her dogs as if they were her own.

The program includes walks in the fresh air, canine socialization, and cuddles… I would entrust my dog ​​to Pépette without hesitation.

And for those who are having trouble keeping up: you can follow their adventures on their Instagram account, just like you keep an eye on your children with a baby monitor!
